design.I_meaning: I is a fresh conversation with a model-visible payload byte-identical to F.
design.output_budget_scope: Every primary, required closed-model, and remote-anchor execution uses the same 1024-token output cap through a provider-native request-field mapping.
design.closed_model_seed_claim: Closed slots are not claimed bitwise or seed deterministic; returned seed or fingerprint fields are logged but not relied upon.
design.comparison_scope: Secondary robustness only; no model ranking, primary-row reuse, or pooling with the 24-task result; conclusions are limited to the four prespecified sentinel tasks.
design.candidate_state_rule: B/F/S use the primary admission SLA; I is excluded.

boolean_summary.valid_pair_count: Count of non-null values in the six registered pairs.
boolean_summary.agreement_count: Count of true values among valid pairs.
boolean_summary.agreement_rate_valid: agreement_count / valid_pair_count; undefined when valid_pair_count is zero

score_delta_summary.raw_absolute_private_score_deltas: Six block-ordered values in [0,1] or null when the F/I pair is Invalid.
score_delta_summary.median_absolute_delta: Median of non-null absolute deltas; undefined when valid_pair_count is zero.
score_delta_summary.maximum_absolute_delta: Maximum of non-null absolute deltas; undefined when valid_pair_count is zero.

repeatability_reduction.missingness_rule: Invalid F/I pairs remain null and are counted in registered denominator 6; they are never imputed as agreements or disagreements.
repeatability_reduction.aggregation_boundary: Never pool model slots or sentinel tasks. Cross-model displays retain one task-model cell per endpoint and show unavailable slots explicitly.

primary_model_reference.alias_label_mapping_status: The exact request alias is frozen; the provider/user-facing paper label is reported, but their deployment mapping is not independently attested.

preflight_contract.registry_snapshot: Persist exact alias discovery or format-only preflight status without credentials or paper-task private payloads.
preflight_contract.unavailable_required_slot: Record provider_or_model_unavailable and mark cross-model robustness incomplete without invalidating the primary FG1 design.

successor_policy.reason: User scope forbids local-model experiment design; the local open-weight slot is removed before materialization and before any provider call.
